title: StimmFolgen - real hosted Apertus, private local reflection

chapters.label: Find a vote
chapters.narration: StimmFolgen helps a voter follow a Swiss vote and understand its evidence. Search for AHV to find the pension initiative and its separate financing proposal.

chapters.label: Track the topic
chapters.narration: My votes keeps the topics I follow. Tracking does not record a Yes or No choice. The official update gives me a reason to return.

chapters.label: Real hosted Apertus
chapters.narration: Ask Apertus sends only this explicit public question to Apertus version 1.5, eight billion, on Public AI. Visitors need no model download. My Mac is not the server.

chapters.label: Source-backed live explanation
chapters.narration: Apertus explains the proposed pension supplement using five reviewed historical facts. Source buttons resolve from immutable references. Fresh answers remain AI generated and are not human reviewed.

chapters.label: Original evidence and dates
chapters.narration: Here are the original German passages, government attribution, booklet pages and dates. The historical explanation uses evidence available before the March 2024 vote.

chapters.label: Honest withholding
chapters.narration: The separate check uses the same model and can still fail. When a candidate does not pass, the app withholds it. It gives no voting recommendation.

chapters.label: What happened later
chapters.narration: Updates are separate from that historical frame. This dated official implementation update is publisher information, not a generated claim about current law.

chapters.label: Follow the next decision
chapters.narration: Related votes connects the pension initiative to the distinct financing proposal, with an official relationship source.

chapters.label: Understand different situations
chapters.narration: Perspectives separates a worker, a pension recipient, other people and Switzerland. Financing uncertainty stays visible. Unknown personal cost does not mean zero.

chapters.label: Private reflection
chapters.narration: This is a synthetic demonstration note. Choices and notes stay on the device. An optional passphrase encrypts saved records; reload locks them, and unlocking restores them.

chapters.label: Free with disclosed limits
chapters.narration: The hosted demo uses finite starter credit, with a hard shared allowance and a seven day credential. Global Cloudflare hosting is clearly distinguished from Swiss sovereign deployment.

chapters.label: An optional local route
chapters.narration: Apple Silicon users can instead install the pinned Apertus model and run inference locally without an API key. One reviewed AHV case works today; broader accuracy remains unproven.
